source_scope: applies to constraints formed only by linear postprocessing of source Euler rows at one fixed symbol; it does not classify nonfactor boundary, constraint, or KT/BFV maps

theorem.constraint_class: Q=L H for an arbitrary linear Euler-row postprocessor L
theorem.positive_quotient_necessary_condition: ker(H)=im(d) whenever im(d) subset ker(H) and rad(H|ker(Q))=im(d)
theorem.radical_inclusion: ker(H) subset rad(H restricted to ker(Q))
